requirements.title: CFI_cdesc_t fixed member order, intermediate placement, and member types are constrained

requirements.definition: The first three CFI_cdesc_t members are base_addr, elem_len, and version in that order; dim is the final member; all other members are between version and dim; the required members have the types named in 18.5.3.

pending.cfi-cdesc-other-members-between-version-: Use offsetof checks proving each required intermediate member rank, type, and attribute has offset greater than version and less than dim; no relative order among those intermediate members is asserted.
pending.cfi-cdesc-required-member-types: Compile assignment probes requiring void * for base_addr, size_t for elem_len, int for version, CFI_rank_t for rank, CFI_type_t for type, CFI_attribute_t for attribute, and CFI_dim_t elements for dim; mutation assigns through an incompatible pointer helper.

requirements.source: S18.5.3 p2 base_addr required values; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF532.

pending.base-addr-null-for-disassociated-pointer: Pass a disassociated pointer dummy descriptor to C, initialize an integer sentinel to -77, and set it to one only after desc->base_addr == NULL; mutation associates the pointer to a target before the call.
pending.base-addr-nonnull-for-zero-size-object: Pass an allocated zero-size allocatable array descriptor to C and assert base_addr is not NULL while extent is zero; mutation expects NULL.
pending.base-addr-scalar-c-address: Pass a scalar interoperable actual with value 37 through a descriptor-producing interface and assert desc->base_addr is the C address whose dereferenced value is 37; mutation compares against a separate scalar address.
pending.base-addr-array-first-element-c-address: Pass a rank-one array [41,43,47] and assert dereferencing base_addr yields 41 and dim[0].extent equals 3; mutation expects the second element value 43.

Permission for arbitrary relative order among members placed between version and dim.
Required nullness and base-address values for base_addr.

Required scalar and element storage-size values for elem_len.
Required version, rank, type, and attribute metadata values.
